name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_10' is a real chapter ID (1-30 are meaningful domain IDs, not address residue); 'post_action' accurately names this as a per-chapter turn-cycle post-action handler. No Ghidra address residue. Name matches role: dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table[9] @ 0x51B19 and matches the sibling naming pattern in chpost.c.
purpose: Chapter 10 turn-cycle post-action handler: runs the default battle win/lose check, then forces game-over if either of the two escort NPCs (runtime_char slots 0x32, 0x33) has died.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_check_battle_end_condition() (default win/lose). Then tests fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x32) and, only if that slot is alive, fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x33). If both are alive, returns (leaving the default flag intact). If either is dead, sets data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code @ 0x53ECC = 1 (game over). The OR short-circuits: slot 0x33 is only queried when slot 0x32 is alive.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: The cdecl argument the dispatch site (fd2_game_main_loop) pushes when invoking handler-table entries = the active char_idx. This handler ignores it; cast to (void) in src. Watcom __CHK prologue also touches it.
params.reason: Not an address residue and not misleading: it correctly denotes the single arg supplied at the dispatch site. Uniformly named 'event_arg' across all sibling handlers in chpost.c; renaming this one alone would break family consistency for an arg the body never uses.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect is the possible write of data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code @ 0x53ECC = 1.

notes: src comment block (chpost.c lines 45-60) was already accurate, precise and ASCII; kept as-is. Ghidra plate was updated only to replace stale placeholder symbol names (game_event_flag / runtime_char[..] / per_chapter_post_action_handler[9]) with the settled src symbol names (data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code / data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table) and to note the cdecl arg = active char_idx pushed by fd2_game_main_loop; semantics unchanged. Dispatch confirmed: table @ 0x51B19 entry [9] = bytes 07 07 02 00 = 0x00020707; fd2_game_main_loop calls (*table[current_chapter_id])() pushing ESI=char_idx. No logic changes made (refine-only).
